nodes.description: Immutable reference to the ToshiCashNonTradable ERC20-like token used for points in the vending machine.
Immutable reference to the ToshimonMinter ERC1155 card contract used as the card token.
Mapping of card id to its point cost, written by addCard and read by claim/redeem.
Public function that burns ToshiCash from msg.sender and mints RMU cards to msg.sender.
Public function that burns RMU cards from msg.sender and mints ToshiCash back to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that registers the point cost of a card id.
Caller address in claim, used as the account whose ToshiCash is burned and as RMU mint recipient.
Caller address in redeem, used as the account whose RMU cards are burned and as ToshiCash mint recipient.
External call to ToshiCash.burn(msg.sender, amount) performed before the matching RMU.mint in claim.
External call to RMU.mint(msg.sender, card, quantity, "") in claim after burning points.
External call to RMU.burn(msg.sender, card, quantity) performed before the matching ToshiCash.mint in redeem.
External call to ToshiCash.mint(msg.sender, amount) in redeem after burning cards.
Private balance ledger of the ToshiCash non-tradable token.
Private total supply of the ToshiCash non-tradable token.
onlyMinter entry point that mints ToshiCash via internal _mint.
onlyMinter entry point that burns ToshiCash via internal _burn after a balance check.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and _balances for the account.
Internal burn that decreases _totalSupply and _balances for the account.
Public ERC1155 transfer entry point that validates operator and calls back into the recipient contract.
Internal ERC1155 balance mutation for a single id transfer.
Internal function that invokes onERC1155Received on a contract recipient, an external callback surface.
ERC1155 nested mapping of owner to id to balance.
Caller address used by safeTransferFrom to authorize the transfer.
External call into the recipient contract before/around balance finalization, the reentrancy entry point of ERC1155.
Private owner address used for access control.
onlyOwner modifier enforcing that the caller is the owner.
